bio: Visciant is the pure spirit of the Light. Long ago, corrupt High Angel Sariel blackmailed his way to the top of the Lightseekers, then began to use his power to exile true believers. A young acolyte prayed to Serenity for answers – and Visciant was her answer. Sariel did not last long after that.
